notes.title: Follow-Up Game's Demo Coming to SAGE 2025!
notes.content: [p][/p][previewyoutube="ouFAEwH8EsM;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Hey, folks![/p][p][/p][p]In case you didn't know, [i]Meander Land[/i] is actually a prequel to a game that's been in development for quite a while. The "main" game is called Meander Forth, and is a platformer about an otter named Garret who must rescue his friends from an outbreak of Dark Magic. [/p][p][/p][p]Admittedly, it's a bit of a departure from Meander Land's style, but a lot of its identity is still intact. The focus on momentum-based block platforming is the same as ever. If you squint, you might see some familiar faces, as well.[/p][p][/p][p]The upcoming demo features the game's first three chapters ("Chapter 0: Teak's Tall Tale," Chapter 1, and Chapter 2).[/p][p][/p][p]I hope you give this game a shot when it releases! I need your feedback now more than ever. [/p][p][/p][p]Hopefully, I'll have this game's steam page ready before too long, as well![/p]

notes.title: New Game Released: WordScoop!
notes.content:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="rVpFsW3mCEw;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3797690/WordScoop_With_Gelato_the_Otter/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Hey, folks! I've finally released my new game: WordScoop With Gelato the Otter![/p][p][/p][p]This is a new word-searching puzzle game inspired by PC games of the early 2000's where you help a space otter find words in a matrix of ice cream scoops![/p][p][/p][p]This game was my college capstone project, so it's satisfying to see it come to fruition. I hope you give it a shot![/p]

notes.title: Wishlist My New Game: WordScoop!
notes.content: [h2]Introducing: [i]WordScoop! With Gelato the Otter[/i][/h2][previewyoutube="fxTCEa_lGEI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][b]Hey, folks![/b][/p][p][/p][p]As of late, I've been finishing up a new game: [i]WordScoop! With Gelato the Otter.[/i] The gameplay revolves around finding words hidden within a matrix of ice cream scoops, while trying to prevent creatures called VOIDs from reaching the bottom. [/p][p][/p][p][i]WordScoop[/i] was actually developed as my senior thesis project in college! For the assignment, I wanted to challenge myself by making a sort of game I've never done before. [/p][p][/p][p]If you've seen the trailer, you may have noticed that the game hearkens back to some of the downloadable computer games of the early 'oughts, albeit with its own spin! [/p][p][/p][p]I would be honored if you put the game on your wishlist. I'm between jobs and planning to someday do GameDev full time, so your support means the world to me![/p][p][/p][p][b]Link to Steam Page:[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3797690/WordScoop_With_Gelato_the_Otter/?curator_clanid=4777282"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]
